column1: # Elixir definition rule. Recorded: defmodule (package), defprotocol (interface), defimpl (class,
# named by the protocol it implements); def, defp, defmacro, defmacrop, defguard, defguardp and
# defdelegate (function, or method inside a defprotocol), ONE SYMBOL PER FUNCTION AND ARITY: the
# consecutive clauses of one name and arity (a bodiless head, guarded clauses, clauses without
# parentheses) are one symbol that starts at the first clause; f/1 and f/2 are two symbols, and so is a
